title: Sort Array by Increasing Frequency
statement: Sort values by increasing frequency; ties are ordered by decreasing numeric value.

title: Sort Array by Increasing Frequency
statement: Sort values by increasing frequency; ties are ordered by decreasing numeric value.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[] frequencySort(int[] nums){Map<Integer,Integer>c=new HashMap<>();for(int x:nums)c.put(x,c.getOrDefault(x,0)+1);Integer[]a=Arrays.stream(nums).boxed().toArray(Integer[]::new);Arrays.sort(a,(x,y)->{int d=Integer.compare(c.get(x),c.get(y));return d!=0?d:Integer.compare(y,x);});return Arrays.stream(a).mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();} }

title: Richest Customer Wealth
statement: Return the largest sum among all customer account rows.
code: class Solution { public int maximumWealth(int[][] accounts){int best=0;for(int[]row:accounts){int s=0;for(int x:row)s+=x;best=Math.max(best,s);}return best;} }

title: Count the Number of Consistent Strings
statement: Count words containing only characters present in allowed.

title: Count the Number of Consistent Strings
statement: Count words containing only characters present in allowed.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int countConsistentStrings(String allowed,String[] words){Set<Character>s=new HashSet<>();for(char c:allowed.toCharArray())s.add(c);int ans=0;for(String w:words){boolean ok=true;for(char c:w.toCharArray())if(!s.contains(c)){ok=false;break;}if(ok)ans++;}return ans;} }

title: Determine if String Halves Are Alike
statement: Return true when the first and second halves contain the same number of vowels.
code: class Solution { public boolean halvesAreAlike(String s){int m=s.length()/2,a=0,b=0;String v="aeiouAEIOU";for(int i=0;i<m;i++){if(v.indexOf(s.charAt(i))>=0)a++;if(v.indexOf(s.charAt(i+m))>=0)b++;}return a==b;} }

title: Maximum Units on a Truck
statement: Maximize units loaded while respecting the truck's box capacity.
approach_name: Load highest units per box first

title: Maximum Units on a Truck
statement: Maximize units loaded while respecting the truck's box capacity.
approach_name: Load highest units per box first
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int maximumUnits(int[][] boxTypes,int truckSize){Arrays.sort(boxTypes,(a,b)->Integer.compare(b[1],a[1]));int ans=0;for(int[]x:boxTypes){int take=Math.min(truckSize,x[0]);ans+=take*x[1];truckSize-=take;if(truckSize==0)break;}return ans;} }

title: Decode XORed Array
statement: Given encoded[i]=arr[i] XOR arr[i+1] and arr[0], reconstruct arr.
approach_name: Recover each next value using XOR
code: class Solution { public int[] decode(int[] encoded,int first){int[]out=new int[encoded.length+1];out[0]=first;for(int i=0;i<encoded.length;i++)out[i+1]=out[i]^encoded[i];return out;} }

title: Find the Highest Altitude

code: class Solution { public int largestAltitude(int[] gain){int cur=0,best=0;for(int x:gain){cur+=x;best=Math.max(best,cur);}return best;} }
